title: {{NAME}} and the Dinosaur Who Was Too Loud
moral: Being kind and patient helps everyone feel better.

pages.content: Now the dinosaur had friends. He used a soft, quiet voice. The animals played all afternoon. Being kind and patient helps everyone feel better. Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Sleep well. Tomorrow the dinosaur whispered something secret. What could it be?
